description: Read one event by resource_id, preferably from a previous result, or by the calendar_id and uid pair. Use list_events for range searches. Request raw iCalendar only for controlled diagnostics because it may contain sensitive calendar data.

calendar_id.description: Opaque calendar ID returned by list_calendars. Provide it together with uid when resource_id is unavailable.

include_raw_ical.description: Include the raw iCalendar resource for controlled diagnostics; it may contain sensitive calendar data. Defaults to false.

resource_id.description: Opaque event resource ID returned by list_events or get_event. Provide it alone instead of calendar_id and uid.

uid.description: iCalendar UID of the event. Provide it together with calendar_id when resource_id is unavailable.

name: get_event

alarms.description: Normalized alarms attached to the event.

items.description: A normalized alarm returned by iCloud Calendar.

description.description: Stored alarm notification text, when available.

minutes_before.description: Whole minutes before event start, when representable.

calendar_id.description: Opaque ID of the containing calendar.

date_time.description: Stored ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and an explicit UTC offset or Z.

timezone.description: IANA timezone associated with the stored date-time.

etag.description: Current ETag for optimistic concurrency, when available.

href.description: Redacted fingerprint of the CalDAV resource URL.

raw_ical.description: Raw iCalendar resource, included only when explicitly requested.

recurrence_exception.description: Whether this result is an overridden recurrence instance.

recurrence_id.description: Occurrence identifier for an expanded recurring event.

recurring.description: Whether this event belongs to a recurring series.

resource_id.description: Opaque event ID accepted by get_event, update_event, and delete_event.

rrule.description: Stored RFC 5545 recurrence rule without the RRULE: prefix.

date_time.description: Stored ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and an explicit UTC offset or Z.

timezone.description: IANA timezone associated with the stored date-time.

title: Get calendar event
